question: A tailor had 49 meters of fabric. They multiplied by 6 when restocking. Then added 67 meters from a supplier. They subtracted 91 meters for large orders. Then subtracted 111 meters for another client project. Finally, subtracted 118 meters for alterations and the remaining stock. Considering that double the original amount would be typical for the season, how much fabric does the tailor have now?

On Saturday morning a scout troop had 78 tent pegs in the kit box. They lost 21 pegs on the walk up the hill and bent 14 more while pitching camp. In the afternoon the quartermaster found that each usable peg had 9 spare washers threaded onto it. That evening 8 of those washers rolled into the stream and were lost. A leader then handed over 71 washers from his own kit. How many washers did the troop have?
A business had 219 items. Their partner had 250 items. They multiplied by 4. They removed 212. They added 15. They multiplied by 5. They added 33. How many items?

A print shop bound 141 folders, and each folder holds 9 booklets. Every booklet contains 6 pages. The pages were then shared equally between 6 archive boxes, and the first archive box took one share. That box's pages were later split equally between 3 shelves, with the top shelf taking the first part. The counter is 4 metres long, the shop has been open for a dozen years, and it quotes its jobs in minutes rather than hours. How many pages are on the top shelf?
In the morning, a factory had 116 units. By afternoon, 30 units were removed. By evening, 22 units were added. They divided by 3. Finally, 7 units were removed. How many units do they have?

In the morning Ray's dairy collected 81 gallons of milk. Since a gallon is 8 pints, and a pint is 2 cups, Ray recorded the morning's milk in cups. In the afternoon Sal's dairy reported 9 times as many cups as Ray's. Sal's dairy produced the same amount on each of 8 days. In the evening of the last day Sal added 36 cups from a spare churn and 74 cups from a late milking. How many cups of milk did Sal's dairy produce in all?

A warehouse had 209 boxes initially. They removed 134 for delivery. They divided by 3 for three stores. They multiplied by 2 for both seasons. They added 66 more from suppliers. The manager earned 20 dollars hourly. How many boxes did each store get?

Halima takes more stall space at the craft fair than her colleague Rui does. She began the season with 239 wooden toys, and her workshop delivered 57 more. Rui handed over 36 toys he had not sold. A department store then placed an order that took her book to 4 toys for every toy she held, and a catalogue firm followed with one that took it to 5 toys for each of those. A school added a final order of 80 toys. The firm quotes production times in weeks although the workshop plans in days. How many toys are in Halima's order book?

A runner had 97 miles. He multiplied by 7 through training expansion. He subtracted 226 from injury recovery. He added 78 from additional training. He added 59 from bonus miles. He multiplied by 9 for seasonal scaling (measured in seasonal miles). Throughout the season, morning runs, afternoon intervals, and evening recovery formed one continuous progression. What was the seasonal mile count?

In the morning, a movie theater had 112 empty seats before the first showing. By midday, 87 more seats filled up as customers arrived. In the afternoon, the theater added 76 more seats by opening an overflow section. Later, 66 more seats were added by opening a second overflow section. By evening, 12 more seats were added for a special late screening. How many seats did the theater have available by evening?
A business had 213 items. Their partner had 200 items. They removed 136. They added 8. They removed 7. They doubled. How many items?

Yara had 67 minutes of studio time on her card and topped it up with 9 more. A long take used 47 minutes and a retake used another 3. Her bandmate Cai, who books far less studio time than Yara does, borrowed 17 minutes from her card. The studio refunded her 5 minutes after a power cut, then charged her 4 minutes for cleaning. The card is sold in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes are left on Yara's card?

Two shop owners, Ines and Baptiste, track candle stock, but this story follows only Ines's stock, which started at 57 candles, more than Baptiste's shop had. In the morning, 32 candles were sold to early customers. In the afternoon, 23 more candles were made. That afternoon, the stock was split evenly among 6 display shelves, and this story follows just one shelf. That shelf then lost 4 candles to breakage, after a delivery that took about 30 minutes, roughly half an hour. That evening, a matching restock multiplied that shelf's candles by 6. Finally, 22 more candles were added from a late batch. How many candles were on that shelf by the end of the evening?

A food bank started the morning with 194 pounds of pasta in storage, unrelated to the 300 cans of soup donated separately that day. By midmorning, 28 pounds were distributed to local families. A grocery store donated 49 more pounds. A farm delivered 46 more pounds. Since the food bank logs weight in pounds but its national report converts everything to kilograms, staff always double-checked the numbers. By afternoon, 230 pounds were sent to a partner shelter. A final matching donation made the remaining total grow to 6 times its size. How many pounds of pasta were left after that donation?

A candle maker packed her stock into 46 cartons, and a dozen helpers carried them. Each carton holds 4 bags, and each bag holds 4 candles. She also had 23 candles on the counter and 13 candles in the window display. She then shared all the candles equally among 4 market stalls, one of which was the Bay stall. How many candles did the Bay stall receive?

Bruno came back from the coast with 25 boxes of shells, and each box held 8 shells. His sister Carla, who had filled far more boxes than he had, gave him 79 shells from her own collection. He found 15 of his shells broken when he unpacked them and threw those away. A second trip added 71 shells to the tray. The walk to the beach takes 40 minutes. Every shell in the tray was threaded onto a cord with 3 wooden beads. How many wooden beads did Bruno use?

A publishing house starts a print run with 86 copies of a novel proofed, in an office that also has 40 unrelated staplers in a supply closet. A distributor order multiplies the print run by 7. A second distributor order multiplies it by 3. A national retailer order then multiplies it by 5. Afterward, 5795 copies are shipped out to warehouses across the country. Finally, 64 more copies are printed for a book tour. How many copies does the publishing house have on hand now?
A chef had 201 portions. He added 52. He multiplied by 3. He added 38 more. He multiplied by 4. He multiplied by 4. How many portions?

A team began with 146 members. They added 72 new recruits. Then 39 more joined. The team multiplied by 4 through partnerships. They added 24 additional roles. Finally, 61 more joined. A sister team had 500 members but independent. How many total team members now?

A business had 131 clients. They multiplied by 9 to 1,179. They added 79, reaching 1,258. They multiplied by 4 to 5,032. They removed 4,888, leaving 144. They multiplied by 7 to 1,008 clients. How many clients total?

A city library began the year with 231 audio recordings, and a donation added 73 more. The librarian had every recording copied so that each one existed as 2 separate files. Each file was afterwards split into 4 chapter tracks for streaming. The library's reading room seats 120 people. A volunteer then uploaded 79 extra tracks recorded at a local event. The catalogue lists every track length in minutes, even though the annual report gives them in hours. How many tracks did the library's collection contain?

A collector had 122 vinyl records stacked along his living room wall. He sold 110 of them to a dealer who came with a van. The record shop in town has 3 listening booths. Every record he kept came with 2 printed inserts inside the sleeve. He mislaid 16 of the inserts during a house move. Sorting through a box, he found 5 more inserts he had forgotten about, and he later gave 12 inserts to a friend who was framing them. How many inserts did the collector still have?

Lena's mill runs 137 looms, and each loom holds 6 reels of thread. Every reel is wound from 5 spools. A supplier sent 77 spare spools to the mill, and 22 spools arrived damaged and were thrown away. Each spool carries 8 lengths of thread, and every length is folded 6 times before packing. Lena's partner Georg runs fewer looms than she does at his own mill across the valley. How many folds are made in the mill's thread?

A company started with 201 revenue. Morning brought 29 more. This was multiplied by 4. She added 35. She added 55. She removed 445 in expenses. She added 45 from a refund. Measured in dollars to cents conversion, how much did she have?

A business had 214 clients. They removed 52, leaving 162. They doubled to 324. They removed 131, leaving 193. They tripled to 579. They multiplied by 4 to 2,316. They multiplied by 5 to 11,580 total clients. How many clients total?
